outcome: Step 4 of the core design audit: health-tree 0.9.0 keeps volatile observation state out of the engine and policy snapshots (its ADR 0041), and Homeostatic pins it. The store file fell from 7.22 MB to 6.68 MB, the engine section from 2.23 MB to 1.75 MB of compact JSON, and two copies a minute apart in a quiet stretch are byte-identical. Idle writes stayed near the step 3 rate, 0.83 a minute, and now come in pairs around one source that opens and resolves an issue every few minutes rather than from snapshot churn.
plan: Core design audit order of work, step 4 (library snapshot holds durable facts only)
